# ankra_cluster_custom_dns_zones (Data Source)

Lists the zones a cluster serves with the organisation's own DNS credentials: its own declarations and the organisation-wide ones it inherits. The counterpart of `ankra cluster custom-dns-zones list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster_custom_dns_zones" "prod" {
  cluster_id = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cluster id.
- `zones` (Attributes List) Zones the cluster serves. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `credential_name` (String) Credential that publishes into the zone.
- `credential_provider` (String) `cloudflare`, `webhook` or `avura`; null when the credential is gone.
- `policy` (String) `upsert-only` or `sync`.
- `source` (String) `cluster` or `organisation`.
- `zone` (String) Zone name.
